note: 学生编号查询由 UNIQUE(student_id,subject_id,semester) 自动索引覆盖，无需额外索引，因此不列入对比。

queries.name: 按课程+学期统计人数
plan_with_index: SEARCH grades USING COVERING INDEX idx_grades_subject_sem (subject_id=? AND semester=?)
plan_without_index: SEARCH grades USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_grades_1 (ANY(student_id) AND subject_id=? AND semester=?)

queries.name: 按课程统计人数
plan_with_index: SEARCH grades USING COVERING INDEX idx_grades_subject_sem (subject_id=?)
plan_without_index: SEARCH grades USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_grades_1 (ANY(student_id) AND subject_id=?)

queries.name: 按班级筛选学生
plan_with_index: SEARCH students USING COVERING INDEX idx_students_class (class_name=?)
